title: Second Greater Position
statement:
Use two monotonic stacks. For each index i, consider indices j > i with a[j] > a[i], in increasing index order. Return the second such index, or 0 if fewer than two exist.

Input
The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.

Output
Print n answers in index order, using 1-based positions.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹. Aim for O(n) time.
